mostWorthwhile.text: The calcium-triggered contraction was most worthwhile: the planned sequence connects calcium, ATP and myosin cycling while showing that filaments slide rather than shorten.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building the two muscles was somewhat repetitive, although the different head arrangements added anatomical detail.

surprise.text: Relaxation also requires ATP to pump calcium back into storage; the fibre lengthens under an outside pull rather than actively pushing itself longer.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, though most choices were the only offered combination, so their compatibility was supplied rather than discovered.

continue.text: Yes. I would continue to see how these muscle and joint constructions connect to larger systems; the progression from filament sliding to opposing elbow movements was engaging.
